edges.reason: block.timestamp is a seed input of the _randMod pseudo-randomness, making the tokenId miner-influenceable
block.timestamp is a seed input of pickgold, so gold NFT selection depends on miner-controlled time
msg.sender is hashed into the _randMod seed and can be chosen by the attacker
msg.sender is used to build the merkle leaf, as mint recipient and as per-wallet limit key in mintEarlySaleNFT
msg.sender is used to build the merkle leaf and per-wallet limit key in mintPreSaleNFT
withdraw forwards the entire contract balance to the caller-controlled msg.sender
tokenId produced by _randMod is minted inside mintEarlySaleNFT
_randMod return value is assigned to tokenId in mintEarlySaleNFT
pickgold output decides whether the freshly minted token becomes gold
users[msg.sender] counters are read and written for early-sale limits
merkleRootEarlySale is consumed by MerkleProof.verify inside mintEarlySaleNFT
onlyOwner writes merkleRootEarlySale in updateMerkleRootEarlySale
onlyOwner writes merkleRootPreSale in updateMerkleRootPreSale
onlyOwner writes baseURI used to build token metadata
_owner storage is written inside _transferOwnership, the privileged ownership state
EARLYSALE_MINTED is incremented after the _safeMint external callback, allowing counter inconsistency
goldNFT.push happens after the external callback triggered by _safeMint
isGold[tokenId] is written after the external callback triggered by _safeMint
mintBreedingNFT records the newly minted gold token into goldNFT
onlyOwner toggles earlysaleEnable, a privileged sale gate
onlyOwner toggles presaleEnable, a privileged sale gate
onlyOwner toggles saleEnableBatchOne, a privileged sale gate
onlyOwner toggles saleEnableBatchTwo, a privileged sale gate
onlyOwner toggles breedingEnable, a privileged sale gate
onlyOwner overwrites EARLYSALE_PRICE used in the mint value check
onlyOwner overwrites PRESALE_PRICE used in the mint value check
onlyOwner overwrites SALE_PRICE_BATCH_ONE
onlyOwner overwrites SALE_PRICE_BATCH_TWO
Merkle proof verification result gates the early-sale mint require
Merkle proof verification result gates the pre-sale mint require
nonce is consumed as part of the _randMod randomness computation
indices array is read and mutated by _randMod for unique tokenId selection
mintEarlySaleNFT calls MerkleProof.verify to validate the caller
mintPreSaleNFT calls MerkleProof.verify to validate the caller
mintGiveawayNFT mints through _safeMint, which performs an external callback
mintReservedNFT mints through _safeMint, which performs an external callback
mintEarlySaleNFT calls _safeMint before updating counters and gold state
mintPreSaleNFT calls _safeMint before updating counters and gold state
mintSaleNFTBatchOne calls _safeMint inside its mint loop
mintSaleNFTBatchTwo calls _safeMint inside its mint loop
mintBreedingNFT calls _safeMint after burning the three input tokens
mintBreedingNFT burns NFTOne, NFTTwo and NFTThree via _burn
_safeMint requires the onERC721Received check performed by _checkOnERC721Received
_safeMint first mints the token through _mint
withdraw executes a low-level send of the balance to the owner, transferring control
transferOwnership delegates the privileged write to _transferOwnership
renounceOwnership delegates the privileged write to _transferOwnership
_msgSender supplies the caller used by the onlyOwner gate guarding owner functions
_checkOnERC721Received invokes the untrusted onERC721Received function on the recipient contract
a malicious receiver can re-enter mintEarlySaleNFT while counters are not yet updated
a malicious receiver can re-enter mintBreedingNFT during the receiver callback

normalization_plan.reason: _to is only used as the _safeMint recipient inside mintGiveawayNFT
_count bounds the mint loop and the GIVEAWAY_MINTED check in mintGiveawayNFT
_count bounds the mint loop and the RESERVED_MINTED check in mintReservedNFT
_count drives supply, per-wallet, per-transaction and price checks in mintEarlySaleNFT
merkleProof is passed straight to MerkleProof.verify inside mintEarlySaleNFT
NFTOne is ownership-checked and burned inside mintBreedingNFT
NFTTwo is ownership-checked and burned inside mintBreedingNFT
NFTThree is ownership-checked and burned inside mintBreedingNFT
loopNumber is the only external input of the weak randomness computation in pickgold
newRoot is written directly to merkleRootEarlySale by updateMerkleRootEarlySale
newRoot is written directly to merkleRootPreSale by updateMerkleRootPreSale
tokenId is the weak-randomness output returned by _randMod and minted in mintEarlySaleNFT
loop index i of mintEarlySaleNFT is forwarded to pickgold to select gold tokens
node is the merkle leaf derived from msg.sender and consumed by the proof check in mintEarlySaleNFT
goldNumber is the direct return value of pickgold used for gold assignment in mintEarlySaleNFT
totalSize is derived from MAX_NFT and nonce and used for the modulo and swap logic in _randMod
index is the modular result of the weak keccak256 hash inside _randMod
